_comment: Rules that turn raw map classes and distances into EarthTwin features. These are METHOD CHOICES (team decisions), not measurements. They are PROVISIONAL: proposed by the assistant, team to confirm. Used by pipeline/fetch_context_data.py.

soil_to_regolith._comment: Map a soil class (WRB reference group from SoilGrids, or USDA Soil Taxonomy order/suborder from SSURGO/STATSGO) to the planetary regolith categories in web/data/features.json. Classes not listed stay null/TODO: no forced match.

usda_miscellaneous_areas._comment: SSURGO 'miscellaneous areas' have no soil order; the component name says what the ground is.

usda_great_group_prefixes._comment: The USDA formative element 'Torri-' marks a torric (aridic) moisture regime, i.e. a desert soil.

soil_to_regolith._low_confidence_note: Cryosols/Gelisols are soils with permafrost, not necessarily an ice-RICH mantle; Leptosols are thin soils over rock, close to but not the same as bare rock.

lithology_to_geology._comment: Keyword rules applied to the Macrostrat / USGS map-unit lithology text. If keywords from more than one category match, the result is 'mixed'. No match → null/TODO.

ice_rules._comment: Ground-ice ordinal (0 none, 1 seasonal frost, 2 permafrost/ice in soil, 3 massive ice) from ESA CCI permafrost fraction (PFR, % of the 1 km cell) and MODIS annual minimum surface temperature.
ice_rules._pfr_note: ≥50% = IPA 'continuous' (≥90%) or 'discontinuous' (50–90%) permafrost classes → level 2. 10–50% ('sporadic') → level 2 with LOW confidence. <10% → treated as no permafrost.
ice_rules._seasonal_note: No permafrost but the coldest 8-day MODIS surface temperature is below 0 °C → level 1 (seasonal frost). Otherwise level 0.
ice_rules.massive_ice_note: Level 3 (massive or buried glacier ice) cannot be detected by these datasets. Sites known for massive ice from the literature (e.g. yedoma, buried glacier ice) stay at level 2 until the team adds a cited source.

logistics_rule._comment: Access index 0–1 = mean of an air-access term and a road-access term. Each term = exp(−distance / scale). Scales are team decisions. Communications, permits and safety are NOT captured.
